body: emily-agent/enrichworker.go: ApplEnrichWorker, same shape as CheckinAlertWorker (alerting.go), wired into cron.go's NewAutonomousCycle alongside the alert worker. Polls IDUNA for Apples missing gpt2_fingerprint, calls scripts/serve.py /generate, runs the output through gpt2-alpine-c/pkg/towerprint.Compute() in-process (no Python for the transform), PATCHes the result back via IdunaClient.PatchApple (new method). Async, caller-side, per TOWERPRINT.md section 5's decision - the Apple POST never blocks on :8088, failure mode is field missing + retried, never a lost/slow Apple. IDUNA prerequisite (also done today): GET /api/v1/apples now exposes has_gpt2_fingerprint (both SQLite and MySQL ListApples updated to select metadata; new metadataHasField helper treats a missing key and an explicit null identically) so the worker can find candidates without an N GET-per-Apple scan. Verified live, end-to-end, for real, not just unit tests: rebuilt and restarted the live IDUNA systemd service to pick up the list-endpoint change, started serve.py with the base model (about 400MB RSS - confirmed light enough for this memory-constrained box, unlike the local GPT-2 training attempts earlier today which OOM-killed within seconds), then manually walked the exact pipeline the worker automates against a real Apple (#9932, the FATES DNS northstar completion): called serve.py for real generated text, computed a real towerprint fingerprint, PATCHed it onto the Apple, and confirmed has_gpt2_fingerprint flips from false to true on the list endpoint afterward. No unit tests added for the HTTP-calling logic itself (IdunaClient, generateForFingerprint) - this matches the existing precedent in this codebase (neither IdunaClient nor CheckinAlertWorker, the pattern this worker copies, have any test coverage), and live verification already caught a real bug this session that mocks would have missed entirely (NORN's missing run_id field, S141-04). Known follow-up, not blocking: serve.py is running now but not yet systemd-supervised, so it won't survive a reboot - worth a proper unit at some point. Full workspace go build/go test green (IDUNA + emily-agent). Commits: IDUNA (list endpoint + metadataHasField), EMILY (enrichworker.go + cron.go wiring + IdunaClient.PatchApple).
title: S147-02: GPT-2 tower Apple enrichment worker — built, wired, verified live
